model.summary: Model favors PHI by 5.6 points (67% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (PHI +2.6), Rest days (home minus away) (CAR +1.4), Elo rating (PHI +1.0). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 42.0 total points (PHI 24, CAR 18). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.6), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 0.6), Natural grass field (lowers total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
